questions.questionText: Three of the following share a common property. Which one is the exception?
questions.explanationText: NOON, DEED and PEEP are palindromes of Three letters, whereas PART is not. Hence PART is the odd one out.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the odd one out?
questions.explanationText: BOOK, FOOD and MOON contain the double vowel 'OO', whereas MILK does not. Hence MILK is the odd one out.

questions.explanationText: In the first three pairs the second word is the function of the first, whereas in Chair : Wood the second word is the material of the first. Hence 'Chair : Wood' is the odd one out.

questions.questionText: Three of the following pairs share the same relationship. Which pair is different?
questions.explanationText: The first three pairs are animal and its young one, whereas Horse : Stable is animal and its dwelling. Hence 'Horse : Stable' is the odd one out.

questions.questionText: Three of the following pairs share the same relationship. Which pair is different?
questions.explanationText: The first three pairs are person and workplace, whereas Farmer : Plough is person and tool. Hence 'Farmer : Plough' is the odd one out.

questions.questionText: Three of the following pairs share the same relationship. Which pair is different?

questions.explanationText: In the first three the second item is produced by processing the first in a changed form; Gold : Ring is raw material and finished article shaped without chemical change — more importantly, Gold remains gold whereas milk, grapes and wheat change into a different substance. Hence 'Gold : Ring' is the odd one out.

questions.questionText: Three of the following pairs share the same relationship. Which pair is different?

questions.questionText: Three of the following pairs share the same relationship. Which pair is different?
questions.explanationText: The first three pairs are animal and its dwelling, whereas Fish : Fin is animal and its body part. Hence 'Fish : Fin' is the odd one out.
